SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 (xlsx.full.min.js), Apache-2.0.
Self-hosted so the Excel preview no longer depends on a CDN.
Obtained from npm package "@e965/xlsx@0.20.3" (a mirror that republishes
SheetJS CE releases; the "xlsx" package on npm is stuck at 0.18.5, which has
known security issues fixed in 0.19.3 / 0.20.2).
